name: core
title: core
summary: Shared Mesh compose and runtime directives stamped under core/v0.1.
stamp: importMeshDirectives defaults to this URL (MESH_SPEC_URL). Protocol loaders stamp @transport here separately from their protocol family URL.
notes: Mesh stitching @source uses subgraph: (and optional type:). Apollo Connectors @source uses http: and lives under specs.apollo.dev/connect.
Older Mesh stamps may still import @pubsubOperation / @pubsubPublish from core/v0.1. Prefer the pubsub family for new schemas.

name: pubsub
title: pubsub
summary: PubSub subscription and publish field directives for topic / webhook bindings.
stamp: Target family URL. Compose / loaders still list and stamp these under core/v0.1 today; stamp cutover is a follow-up.
notes: json-schema / OpenAPI loaders stamp @pubsubOperation via importMeshDirectives when the directive is used (currently on the core URL).

name: sql
title: sql
summary: SQL table mapping directive from the Mesh SQL loader (transport-sql).

name: thrift
title: thrift
summary: Thrift binary RPC field mapping directive.
notes: Pair with @transport from core/v0.1. JSON Thrift uses Apollo @connect instead.

name: mongo
title: mongo
summary: MongoDB operation binders from the Mesh Mongo loader.

name: neo4j
title: neo4j
summary: Neo4j GraphQL model directives with optional Mesh subgraph attribution.
notes: Mesh adds optional subgraph: for multi-source attribution; strip before handing model SDL to @neo4j/graphql.

name: auth
title: auth
summary: Mesh-owned auth helper used with Hive Gateway generic auth.
stamp: Hand-authored subgraph SDL + docs @link today (not loader importMeshDirectives). Product family URL is auth/v0.1.

name: rate-limit
title: rate-limit
summary: Field-level rate limit hints for Hive Gateway rateLimiting.
stamp: Hand-authored subgraph SDL + Hive Gateway docs @link today (not loader importMeshDirectives). Product family URL is rate-limit/v0.1.
notes: Enable rateLimiting in the gateway config so directive annotations are enforced.
